# Memo Labs

> Memo Labs is a full-stack & AI studio that designs and ships complete products, from architecture to polished UI — its own SaaS and engineering missions.

## About

Memo Labs is the product studio and playground of Guillaume Flambard: scalable B2B SaaS, AI tools, clinical apps, and complete products shipped end to end — architecture, API, interface, motion. The studio develops its own products and takes on full-stack & AI engineering missions.

## Contact

- Website: https://memolabs.dev
- Lab: https://lab.memolabs.dev
- Email: contact@memolabs.dev
- GitHub: https://github.com/guillaume-flambard

## Flagship products

- [PayKit](https://memolabs.dev/fr/work/paykit): Drop-in billing SDK for AI apps — credits, usage metering and subscriptions.
- [Blue Owl](https://memolabs.dev/fr/work/blueowl): AI lesson generator for global education.
- [Largo IA](https://memolabs.dev/fr/work/largo): Marketing site for an AI-first training agency.
- [PhanganAI](https://memolabs.dev/fr/work/phanganai): Booking and events app for Koh Phangan.

## Lab (WIP)

- [The lab](https://lab.memolabs.dev): All projects — live products, prototypes and WIP experiments with descriptions.
